proved_scope: For rational t, G(t) is symmetric and idempotent.
G(t) fixes every vector (x,t*x) and maps every rational two-vector explicitly onto that graph.
G(t)[0,0] is nonzero and t=G(t)[1,0]/G(t)[0,0], hence the full matrix datum is injective in t.
The diagonal entries alone are identical for t and -t, while G(t)=G(-t) holds exactly when t=0.
For arbitrary elements C,Q of any ring, C*Q=Q implies (2*C-1)*Q=Q and (1-C)*Q=0.
If additionally Q*v=v, then the retained polarization (2*C-1) fixes v.
In any characteristic-zero ring, anticommuting involutions R,F satisfy (R*F)^2=-1 and R is not equal to F.
given_not_derived: the interpretation of t, G, R, or F as operators from the microscopic TFPT source
the compression elements C,Q and the retention premise C*Q=Q
not_proved: an unbounded Hilbert-space logarithm or analytic reconstruction theorem
operator domains, closures, spectral limits, positivity beyond the finite rational matrix
a nontrivial 3+2 carrier selection from positive-only compression; on the retained range the proved polarization is the identity
any alternative factorization or restriction map that could carry a different marking
source state, locality, CAR realization, or a full P1/P2 source derivation
